facts.claim: Vancouver-based Miraterra raised $16M CAD in an oversubscribed round led by At One Ventures to scale its Raman-spectroscopy-based AI soil intelligence platform beyond soil into plants and food.
TerraBlaster closed a $12.5M oversubscribed seed round led by Ulu Ventures for real-time LIBS-based NPK soil nutrient mapping at tractor speed, taking cumulative funding to $16.5M.
Berlin-based Seqana raised EUR 3.2M led by Pymwymic (with HTGF and Counteract) to extend its satellite-and-machine-learning soil health measurement beyond carbon.
Upstream agtech, which includes precision agriculture, raised roughly $9B globally in 2025, up 7% year over year, with precision ag accounting for about a third of all agtech venture value.
Agtech VC deal count collapsed in H1 2026 versus prior periods, with a rebound seen as unlikely for the remainder of the year amid muted exits.
Amsterdam/Boston-based Anterra Capital reached a $100M first close on Fund III (targeting $200M total) to back AI-driven food and agriculture startups, backed by Rabobank, Novo Holdings and Zoetis.
Investors and growers in ag-tech are prioritizing solutions with predictable ROI, reduced operational risk and real-world workflow fit, per 2026 World Agri-Tech Innovation Summit commentary.

active_funds.name: At One Ventures
active_funds.evidence: Led Miraterra's $16M CAD oversubscribed round for its AI-driven soil intelligence platform, joined by Farm Credit Canada, S2G Investments, Sitka Foundation and iSelect.

active_funds.name: Ulu Ventures
active_funds.evidence: Led TerraBlaster's $12.5M oversubscribed seed round for real-time NPK soil mapping at tractor speed, joined by Khosla Ventures, Trailhead Capital, Builders Vision and others.

active_funds.name: Pymwymic
active_funds.evidence: Led Seqana's EUR 3.2M round to extend the Berlin startup's satellite-and-AI soil health measurement beyond carbon, joined by HTGF and Counteract.

active_funds.name: Anterra Capital
active_funds.evidence: Fund III first close targets "AI-driven food and agriculture" startups delivering "scalable, science-based solutions" spanning climate resilience, resource efficiency and regulatory compliance.

facts.claim: The EU Commission adopted Directive (EU) 2026/288 on 2026-02-09, amending the Nitrates Directive with new RENURE fertiliser rules and recommending Member States support precision farming eco-schemes in CAP Strategic Plans to improve fertilisation efficiency.

The European Commission presented legislative proposals on 2025-07-16 for CAP 2028-2034 reform, replacing the two-pillar structure with a single unified fund and shifting income support toward environmental and food-safety conditionality over production.

EU Data Act Chapter II data-sharing rights, giving farmers rights to access and share data generated by their farm IoT devices, applied from 2025-09-12, with the obligation for direct-access device interfaces following from 2026-09-12.

players.name: John Deere
players.evidence: Acquired Sentera (drone-based aerial field scouting and FieldAgent software) on 2025-05-23 to integrate imagery-derived prescriptions into its Operations Center, after a decade-long partnership.

players.name: John Deere
players.evidence: Acquired GUSS Automation, maker of autonomous orchard and vineyard sprayers, completing the deal in September 2025 to expand its high-value-crop autonomy portfolio.

players.name: CropX
players.evidence: Acquired Acclym (formerly Agritask) on 2025-09-02, its seventh strategic acquisition, to add enterprise sustainability and supply-chain data to its soil-sensor-based farm management platform.

players.name: Elbit Systems (FUSE)
players.evidence: Acquired Bluewhite, an autonomous off-road/ag robotics platform with over 100,000 autonomous field operating hours, on 2026-05-27.

players.name: Syngenta
players.evidence: Launched the Cropwise Open Platform with standardized APIs in November 2025 for "third-party developers worldwide," stating "the best innovations for a smallholder in sub-Saharan Africa or a grain producer in Romania may come from developers closer to those contexts."

players.name: Corteva (Corteva Catalyst)
players.evidence: Describes Catalyst as "an investment and collaboration platform dedicated to accelerating the development of technologies that enable farmers around the world to sustainably produce more food and feed."

facts.claim: CropX describes itself as "an M&A machine," having made seven strategic acquisitions in five years to build an integrated digital-agronomy platform around its soil-sensor core.
Ten agtech M&A deals closed in May 2026 alone, double any comparable month, with every one a strategic buy by an established operator rather than a distress sale.

players.name: CropX
players.evidence: CEO Tomer Tzach on acquisition criteria: "Technology? Customers? Revenues? And the answer is yes, yes, and yes"; most of the seven companies acquired since 2020 (incl. Green Brain, EnGeniousAg, Acclym/Agritask) were profitable, not distressed.
